name: Synthetic Futures
description: This keyword will calculate the put call parity and fetch the synthetic futures of the current week based on the same. This can be used to calculate weekly futures and trade based on the same to spot arbitrage opportunities.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword will calculate the put call parity and fetch the synthetic futures of the current week based on the same. This can be used to calculate weekly futures and trade based on the same to spot arbitrage opportunities.

![Example](./images/img-1631867673.png)

The above image shows how can you use synthetic futures as a standalone keyword for other mathematical operations.

![Example](./images/img-1631868027.png)

The above image shows how can you use synthetic futures  to calculate the ATM strike based on the same.

parameters.name: Underlying
parameters.description: Underlying symbol, e.g. 'NIFTY 50'. Computes current-week synthetic futures via put-call parity.
